{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Verify: patient_id has duplicates
print(f'Duplicate patient_id count: {df.duplicated(subset="patient_id").sum()}')

# Deduplicate by patient_id, keeping the row with the highest sample_seq
# This is the correct way to count unique patients, per data dictionary
df_dedup = df.loc[df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Count unique patients
n_patients = len(df_dedup)
print(f'Number of unique patients: {n_patients}')"}
